verdict.rationale: Fern Agent can be scheduled to autonomously review reader feedback, unanswered questions, search queries, or analytics, report findings, and open a PR when appropriate — a genuine background automation. However, this is scoped narrowly to documentation-maintenance tasks rather than general-purpose autonomous automations, and detail on scheduling configuration, reliability, or failure handling is thin. Missing for 10: broader automation scope beyond docs upkeep, independent/hands-on verification of the scheduled agent working reliably, and more detail on configuring/monitoring these background runs.
